set.description: 会求两个集合的并集，并用 |A|+|B|−|A∩B| 计算有限并集的元素个数。
set.name: Union

criteria: 能熟练求有理数的绝对值
能由 |x|=a 求 x
set.description: 按“正数取本身、负数取相反数、0 取 0”的法则求绝对值并作简单化简。
set.name: Simplifying and calculating absolute values

criteria: 能说出数列是有序的
能根据序号指出某一项
set.description: 数列是按一定顺序排成的一列数，每一项都有确定的序号。
set.name: Concept of a Sequence

criteria: 能把序号代入通项公式
能由前几项写出简单的通项
set.description: 通项公式用序号 n 表示第 n 项。知道通项就可以求出指定的一项。
set.name: Formula for the nth term

criteria: 能根据个位判断是不是 2 的倍数
能根据个位判断是不是 5 的倍数
set.description: 知道个位是 0、2、4、6、8 的数是 2 的倍数，个位是 0 或 5 的数是 5 的倍数。
set.name: Characteristics of multiples of 2 and 5

criteria: 能找出一个不太大的数的全部因数
能说出谁是谁的倍数
set.description: 知道因数和倍数是相互依存的，会找一个数的因数和 100 以内的倍数。
set.name: Factors and multiples

criteria: 能说出质数只有 1 和它本身两个因数
能说出 1 既不是质数也不是合数
set.description: 知道质数只有 1 和它本身两个因数，合数有更多因数，1 既不是质数也不是合数。
set.name: Prime and composite numbers

set.reason: A recurrence expresses a later term through earlier ones. That only makes sense once a sequence is understood as an ordered list with definite positions, so computing terms step by step depends on it.
set.scope: ordered terms referenced by previous and next index

set.reason: The target explicitly distinguishes a recurrence relation from a general-term formula; the latter's index-to-term meaning is part of this comparison.
set.scope: distinguishing recurrence formulas from general term formulas

set.reason: The explicit even-number units-digit criterion is the multiple-of-two units-digit test. The multiple-of-five part of the endpoint is outside this required scope.
set.scope: stating the units-digit feature of even numbers

set.reason: The node uses exponents to settle divisibility, gcd and lcm, which are stated in terms of factors and multiples. The factor concept is indispensable, though exhaustive factor listing is not.
set.scope: divisibility meaning of factors and multiples

set.reason: A prime factorization is by definition a product of primes. Recognizing primes, and knowing that 1 is excluded, is necessary both to stop factoring and to state uniqueness.
set.scope: identifying the prime building blocks

criteria: Verify preservation for every allowed operation.
Do not mistake a necessary invariant for sufficient reachability.
set.description: Find a quantity or residue unchanged by every allowed move, prove preservation, and use it to constrain reachable states.
set.name: Invariants in discrete processes

set.name: Simple recurrence relations

criteria: 能找出两个数全部公因数
